profiles.name: Canada

cost.label: ₹24-42L typical first-year study plan
cost.note: Tuition, city and proof-of-funds requirements can make a low budget tight.

settlement.label: Multiple federal and provincial pathways
settlement.note: Long-term options are structured but depend heavily on current programme settings and profile score.

profiles.jobNote: Demand varies sharply by province; regulated professions need licensing.

postStudy.label: PGWP can support eligible graduates
postStudy.note: Programme, institution and field eligibility must be verified before enrolment.

profiles.name: Australia

cost.label: ₹28-48L typical first-year study plan
cost.note: Tuition and living costs favour applicants with a stronger starting budget.

settlement.label: Points-tested, state and regional pathways
settlement.note: Occupation fit, skills assessment, points and nomination control practical timelines.

profiles.jobNote: Healthcare, engineering and trades can be strong where licensing and assessment align.

postStudy.label: Graduate work options for eligible study
postStudy.note: Duration and eligibility depend on qualification, location and current rules.

profiles.name: United Kingdom

cost.label: ₹24-42L typical first-year study plan
cost.note: Shorter master's programmes can reduce total duration, though London costs are high.

settlement.label: Sponsored work route can lead to settlement
settlement.note: Settlement usually relies on moving into and maintaining a qualifying work route.

profiles.jobNote: Sponsorship concentration and live salary thresholds shape the real job market.

postStudy.label: Graduate route after eligible study
postStudy.note: The route is time-limited and does not itself guarantee sponsorship or settlement.

profiles.name: USA

cost.label: ₹30-60L+ typical first-year study plan
cost.note: Scholarships can change the picture, but a conservative plan needs substantial funds.

settlement.label: Employer and family routes are less predictable
settlement.note: Long-term outcomes can depend on employer sponsorship, quotas and route-specific waits.

profiles.jobNote: The market is deep, but work authorisation and sponsorship can be the binding constraint.

postStudy.label: OPT / STEM OPT for eligible graduates
postStudy.note: Duration depends on programme classification and compliance, with sponsorship still a separate step.

profiles.name: New Zealand

cost.label: ₹22-38L typical first-year study plan
cost.note: Costs can be more manageable than some peers, but programme and city still matter.

settlement.label: Skilled and Green List pathways
settlement.note: Occupation and accredited-employer alignment are key to long-term options.

profiles.jobNote: The market is smaller, with strong signals in selected healthcare, construction and trade roles.

postStudy.label: Post-study work for eligible qualifications
postStudy.note: Length and work conditions depend on qualification and current settings.

profiles.name: Europe

cost.label: ₹12-30L range, highly country-dependent
cost.note: Germany and selected continental options can offer lower tuition, but funds and local costs still apply.

settlement.label: Country-specific skilled work and Blue Card routes
settlement.note: There is no single Europe visa; language and national rules determine the route.

profiles.jobNote: Germany-focused signals favour engineering, IT and selected shortage roles; local language widens options.

postStudy.label: Country-specific graduate job-search routes
postStudy.note: Rights and duration vary by country; local language often drives conversion to work.

profiles.name: UAE

cost.label: ₹18-35L typical first-year study plan
cost.note: Proximity and tax context can help, though tuition and Dubai housing vary widely.

settlement.label: Residence is usually tied to work, study or investment
settlement.note: It is stronger for near-term work and residence than conventional permanent settlement.

profiles.jobNote: Commercial, construction and service sectors can be active, with employer quality varying substantially.

postStudy.label: Institution and employer-led transitions
postStudy.note: Post-study conversion is less standardised than in major study destinations.
